Notes

This weight uses the 2006 weighting methodology and is comparable for all years. For more information see the ATUS User's Guide. Cases with [TUYEAR = 2020] will have missing values for TUFNWGTP. Researchers should use the TU20FWGT weight to construct estimates when using the 2020 data. Files: Respondent File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).
